title: Participant Ecology / Behavioural Atlas

amendments.reason: DATA-002 transaction-shape audit showed one active aggregate order can match multiple passive maker fills. Counting the active row as a single economic trade would collapse real passive fill legs. Clock-time silence must also remain missing rather than being imputed as zero movement.
changes: economic market stream reconstructed from passive fill legs within validated family+condition_id+tx_hash match groups; active row retained for conservation audit only
clock-time price targets require at least one later economic fill in (t,t+h]; otherwise label is NO_FUTURE_OBSERVATION

amendments.reason: Completed schema-only DATA-002 conservation audit across all five families showed source float rounding in canonical YES-axis notional: p99 roughly 5e-7 to 1.4e-5, maximum below 4.97e-4, and zero eligible groups above 1e-3. A 1e-8 YES-notional tolerance would therefore reject valid groups for binary-float noise.
changes: canonical YES-axis notional conservation uses relative tolerance 1e-3
value_usd is not a conservation gate because participant-side value semantics do not reconcile as an aggregate match invariant

scientific_question: Does observable participant behaviour contain repeatable predictive information about subsequent market state beyond generic market and activity controls?

data.economic_market_grain: group rows by family+condition_id+tx_hash; require exactly one order_is_match_taker_order=true active aggregate row and one or more passive rows; each passive row is one economic fill; active aggregate row is audit-only and never counted as an additional economic fill
data.economic_trade_validation: require exactly one active aggregate row, at least one passive row, binary outcomes, relative size conservation <=1e-8, and relative canonical YES-axis notional conservation <=1e-3; malformed groups fail closed and are audited; value_usd is not used as a conservation gate
data.identity_policy: known exchange/adapters/protocol/fee/reward/system identities excluded from participant ecology; unknown identity is never asserted human

semantics.canonical_yes_price: YES row: price; NO row: 1-price; OTHER rejected for directional price targets
semantics.participant_yes_pressure: YES BUY or NO SELL = +1; YES SELL or NO BUY = -1; otherwise missing
semantics.aggressor_status: not inferred from participant_side; economic role is outside the primary 005E signal
semantics.market_target_state: last canonical economic-fill YES price observed at or before each horizon, valid only if at least one later economic fill occurs in (t,t+h]; otherwise NO_FUTURE_OBSERVATION
semantics.same_timestamp_policy: participant feature state is formed strictly before the current row under deterministic timestamp, tx_hash, log_index ordering; same-second future rows never enter past state

split.method: within-family chronological timestamp quantiles derived from timestamps only
split.selection_rule: TRAIN characterises and fits transforms; DEV selects predeclared feature families/hyperparameters; HOLDOUT is opened once after immutable DEV freeze

sampling.history: all eligible participant rows are used to build past-only state
sampling.evaluation: deterministic fill-id hash sample after feature construction, outcome-independent
sampling.reason: retain the full history state while bounding supervised fit/inference cost

recurrence: session fill count with 30-minute session break
size_behaviour: current value z-score versus participant past
current value percentile proxy versus contemporaneous market activity
directional_behaviour: past agreement between participant pressure and lagged own-market return
timing_behaviour: activity acceleration proxy from session count versus lifetime rate
historical_markout: 300-second matured directional logit markout cumulative sum/count
empirical-Bayes shrunk historical markout with lambda=20
historical score count and uncertainty proxy
all current scores exclude labels whose 300-second horizon has not matured

archetypes.fit_population: TRAIN participant end-state rows with at least 20 prior fills and 2 active days
archetypes.dev_holdout: assigned with frozen TRAIN scaler/PCA/centroids; no refit
archetypes.cluster_count_selection: fixed before outcome inspection; not chosen by DEV/HOLDOUT predictive performance
archetypes.stability: report adjusted Rand index across deterministic TRAIN bootstrap refits

clock.missingness: price targets are missing when no later economic fill occurs before the horizon

baseline_controls: anonymous economic-trade count and unsigned value over 15/60/300s
common event movement excluding target where computationally available

model_ladder.selection: DEV only; primary comparison is incremental loss of participant-state variants versus generic baseline

screening.primary_metric: out-of-sample squared-error improvement for 60s own-market logit change
screening.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR 0.05 within target x horizon family
screening.dev_candidate_rule: retain only predeclared participant feature families with positive DEV incremental performance and same-sign improvement in at least 3 families or a coherent predeclared regime-specific subset

falsification: participant-state permutation within condition x 30-minute bucket x activity/frequency stratum
shuffled historical-score assignment within support strata
concentration: share of incremental effect from top participant/top5/top10/top1percent using anonymised audit IDs
